excerpt: Compare Ajman property management quotes by scope, fee basis, repair authority, reporting and the total cost to a landlord.
introduction:
The cost of managing an Ajman rental apartment depends on what the manager does and how the agreement charges for it. A percentage quoted for rent collection may not include tenant placement, renewals, inspections, repairs or taxes on services. Ask for a written schedule and calculate the expected annual cost before comparing providers.

This guide uses sample figures to demonstrate the arithmetic. They are not typical market rates or a quotation from Aliyas or another manager.
takeaways: Compare management quotes on the same services, fee basis and tax treatment.
Distinguish an owner's building service charge from a manager's fee and from repair costs.
Set written limits for repairs, reporting, access to funds and termination of the agreement.

sections.heading: What does a management fee cover?
sections.body:
Ask whether the service includes advertising, viewings, tenant checks, preparing the lease, collecting rent, coordinating maintenance and periodic reporting. Some providers quote an annual management fee and charge separately for tenant placement or renewal. Others package services differently. Do not compare percentages until you know the base and scope.

Clarify whether a percentage applies to contracted rent, actually collected rent or another amount, and whether a minimum charge or tax on the service applies. Request a written example using your expected rent and a period with vacancy.

Ajman's [residential lease authentication service](https://ajman.ae/en/happiness-bundle/services/establish-business/authentication-lease-contract-residential-purposes) explains the Tasdeeq process. Ask which party prepares the documents and pays the current authentication charge under the proposed arrangement.

table.caption: Compare two manager proposals on the same basis
rows: What percentage or amount, on which rent base, and when is it due?
Are these included, and when are separate fees charged?
Who approves work, selects contractors and pays a markup?
How often are statements and owner payments provided?
What notice, handover and exit charges apply?

sections.heading: Calculate a sample annual fee
sections.body:
Imagine a manager charges 5% of AED 40,000 rent actually collected, giving an ongoing fee of AED 2,000. In the same example period, assume a separate AED 2,000 placement charge, an AED 500 renewal charge and a 10% coordination markup on AED 3,000 of repairs, or AED 300. The management-related total is AED 4,800. This example assumes both placement and renewal fees fall within the period being compared.

The AED 3,000 repair itself remains a separate expense; it is not included in the AED 4,800 fee total. The example also excludes tax on services, building service charges, insurance and vacancy. The figures and contract terms form a simple example for comparing the two management arrangements.

The chart breaks down the example fees. Replace every assumption with the proposed contract and check for minimum charges and other exclusions.

sections.heading: Separate building and rental management
sections.body:
The building's common-area service charge and the fee for managing your individual tenancy are different items. A building management company may maintain shared facilities, while a landlord's appointed manager may handle the lease and tenant. Check their separate invoices and responsibilities.

[Ajman's 2020 owners' affairs law](https://ajmanre.gov.ae/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/English-%D9%82%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%B1%D9%82%D9%85-3-%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%86%D8%A9-2020-%D8%A8%D8%B4%D8%A3%D9%86-%D8%AA%D9%86%D8%B8%D9%8A%D9%85-%D8%B4%D8%A4%D9%88%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D9%84%D8%A7%D9%83-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A5%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%B1%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D8%AC%D9%85%D8%A7%D9%86.pdf) describes common-area expenses and, for developments within its scope, notice to the building management when a unit is rented. Confirm current requirements for the particular project.

The [Ajman service-charge guide](/journal/apartment-service-charges-in-ajman-explained) explains the distinction and the building documents to request.

sections.heading: Agree repair authority and reporting
sections.body:
Specify the value of work the manager can approve without asking you, how emergencies are handled and when additional quotes are needed. Ask whether the manager receives a commission or adds a markup when appointing contractors. Agree how invoices and before-and-after records will be provided.

For rent and deposits, understand where funds are held, when money reaches the owner and what deductions are permitted. Request regular statements that show amounts due, collected, spent and outstanding. Confirm who follows up late payments and what authority they have to engage a lawyer or begin a dispute process.

Check the provider's licence and permitted activities with the relevant authority. A name on a marketing page does not by itself establish the scope of a firm's licence.

sections.heading: Test the effect on the investment
sections.body:
Deduct the expected manager charges, building service charges, repairs, insurance and other owner-paid costs from rent after a vacancy allowance. Use the [Ajman net rental yield guide](/journal/how-to-calculate-net-rental-yield-in-ajman) to compare net operating income with the total acquisition cost. Do not count the same repair or management charge twice.

Run a second scenario with a longer vacancy or an unplanned repair. A manager may help coordinate work, but a contract does not guarantee a tenant, a particular rent or investment return unless those obligations are expressly agreed and enforceable.

Read the notice and termination provisions. Ask who will hold keys, documents, tenant records and deposits at handover if you change providers.

sections.heading: Compare service levels as well as price
sections.body:
Ask each provider how often they inspect, whether inspection photographs are included, who handles tenant questions and how quickly an urgent issue is escalated. Request a sample statement showing rent received, invoices paid, fees deducted and the amount transferred to the owner. A cheaper quote may be appropriate if you plan to handle some tasks yourself, but only if that division is clear.

Check whether the contract permits the manager to appoint related contractors and whether any commission or discount is disclosed. Ask how quotations are compared and whether you can nominate an approved contractor. Keep the agreed scope and approval limits with the contract so both parties can refer to them when work is needed.

sections.heading: Discuss a current property
sections.body:
Explore the [Ajman area guide](/journal/ajman-property-2026) and the [Aliyas Ajman project collection](/projects?emirate=Ajman) when comparing residential properties. Request the actual unit's current building charges and a written management quote rather than using the illustration as a price.

[Contact Aliyas](/contact) with the property's location, intended lease and the services you need. Verify the provider's licence, scope and agreement before appointing anyone.
